name: CBDC First Time Entrepreneur Loan
provider: Community Business Development Corporations (CBDCs), Newfoundland and Labrador offices

summary.quote: If you are a new entrepreneur with a Startup Business and live in a rural community in Atlantic Canada, you may be eligible for a First Time Entrepreneur Loan from your local CBDC (Community Business Development Corporation).

funding_types.quote: First Time Entrepreneur Loans are repayable, but have competitive interest rates and repayment terms.

max_amount.quote: The CBDC First Time Entrepreneur Loan offers up to $150,000* to qualified borrowers in Atlantic Canada.

criteria.text: Living in a rural area of Atlantic Canada (which includes Newfoundland and Labrador)
criteria.quote: You must be a new, first time entrepreneur living in a rural area of Atlantic Canada;

criteria.text: A sole proprietor, limited company or partnership, controlled by the new entrepreneur
criteria.quote: It’s available to sole proprietors, limited companies and partnerships (when majority control is resides with the new entrepreneur).

criteria.text: You are a new, first-time entrepreneur living in a rural area
criteria.quote: You must be a new, first time entrepreneur living in a rural area of Atlantic Canada;

criteria.text: The loan is for starting a business or buying an existing one
criteria.quote: Loan may be used for a business start-up, or to help buy an existing business;

criteria.text: Your local CBDC offers this loan (programs vary by region)
criteria.quote: Programs and services delivered by CBDCs may vary by region.

research.notes: Structure: sole proprietors, limited companies (corporation) and partnerships; a business not registered yet may become one of those, so unclear; co-operatives and non-profits miss. "New, first time entrepreneur" is not the same as years operating (someone buying an existing business can qualify), so it is check-this-yourself, not a years rule. Purpose is not a rule because buying an existing business is also allowed. The page says CBDCs can exceed $150,000 in certain circumstances. Intake: not stated. Contacts: the offices of CBDC Central (Grand Falls-Windsor), CBDC Gander Area and CBDC Emerald (Baie Verte, with a Springdale satellite office), each quoted from its own cbdc.ca office page saved as a source of this record; all three pages list this loan. Only the Gander Area page names the places it serves (a list of place names, not census divisions), so census_divisions is null for every office and there is no location rule beyond the province (contract question B). Other CBDCs in the province are not listed as contacts. Office labels name the office and its town only, every word of which is in the contact's own quote (DECISIONS #25); the app's line above several contacts tells an owner to call the office nearest them.
